snippet.title: Park Ranger Simulator - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore the relaxing forests of Park Ranger Simulator in this teaser trailer for the upcoming simulation game. Park Ranger Simulator will be available on PS5 (PlayStation 5), Xbox Series X|S, and Steam for PC. 

In Park Ranger Simulator, take on the role of a park ranger in a vast, open-world environment in both single and multiplayer. Manage and protect a diverse 20 km² open world filled with rich wildlife and multiple biomes. Protect the environment, whether you’re protecting the forest, safeguarding the wildlife, repairing park facilities, or maintaining the delicate balance of the ecosystem, every decision you make will impact your success as a ranger.
